issues.issue: Carried over from the first review. This is not a module error, and it is unchanged by the fix. widen_spread moves ask and leaves bid fixed, so the registered mid-based move shifts by (mult - 1)/2 x (close spread at i - close spread at i-4) in the stressed runs. A few episodes cross the move_atr_min x ATR20 margin and sl_dist changes slightly. Re-measured on the module on disk: the spread-ratio mask itself now flips 0 bars at 1.5x and 2x. USDJPY hypothesis cell: 160 -> 162 at 1.5x (0 dropped, 2 added), 163 at 2x (1 dropped, 4 added). The sl_dist relative change has a median of 0.14% / 0.27% and a maximum of 2.2% / 4.4%. EURUSD stays at 64 at both multipliers. The news-included control (stage A only, never stressed) moves more: USDJPY 567 -> 573 / 574 with an sl_dist maximum of 13%, and EURUSD 501 with a maximum of 25% at 2x.
issues.fix: No module change: mid is the registered definition. The Director reads the 1.5x and 2x stress rows as near-identical samples (within about 3 episodes of 160), not identical ones.

lookahead_risk: None found. The fix adds a module constant (TIE_TOL = 1e-9) and multiplies the two thresholds by (1 - TIE_TOL). Both comparisons still use only values known at bar i: |move[i]|, ATR20 of the trading day and spr[i] / norm[i]. The slot median, ATR20, the move, the window overlap, the episode logic and the delay logic are byte-for-byte unchanged from the version verified causal in the first review. I re-ran the engine's leak tests on the module on disk. (1) The checker reproduction (dynamic_check, last 150,000 bars before 2024-01-01): ok, 97 entries. (2) Full USDJPY 2010-2023, in five cells: defaults; delay 1; ratio 0 with news included; move_atr_min 0.4 with news included at delay 1; ratio 0 at move_atr_min 0.4. Truncation at k = 174,674 and 314,413, perturbation in both directions, and determinism all give 0 mismatches. (3) EURUSD, XAUUSD and AUDJPY at both delays give 0 mismatches.
notes: Signals only; no returns or R were computed. posthoc_lwr.py, the Director's post-test diagnostics in the shared scratchpad, was not run. (a) Nothing else changed. I rebuilt the pre-fix source by reversing the single replacement in the Builder's variant_a.py, which is identical to my first-review scratch copy lwr_tol.py. The diff to the module on disk has exactly four hunks: three docstring lines that state the tie rule; `TIE_TOL = 1e-9`; the explanatory comment; and the two comparisons, `abs_move >= float(p["move_atr_min"]) * atr * (1.0 - TIE_TOL)` and `ratio >= float(p["spread_ratio_min"]) * (1.0 - TIE_TOL)`. The brief copy equals the file on disk. The file now has CRLF line endings because the checker rewrites it; the content is unchanged. (b) The fix matches the prescription: a relative 1e-9 tolerance on the ratio, the prescribed comment, and the optional same tolerance on the move threshold. Against my ratio-only patch, the move tolerance changes no Signals field in 2010-2023: 0 mismatches over all 16 USDJPY cells and both delays on the seven other markets. It only guards exact ties that may occur later. (c) Exact reference. I built a new independent implementation in integer-point arithmetic. Prices are on the point grid to within 5e-10. 2 x mid, 2 x median and 20 x ATR20 are integers, and both thresholds are compared with Fractions. It has its own 17:00-New-York ATR, per-slot deque median, minute-set window overlap, and episode and delay logic. It reproduces every Signals field bar for bar over 2010-2023 in 32 of 32 cases: all 16 USDJPY cells, and both delays on EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, EURJPY, GBPJPY, AUDJPY and XAUUSD. (d) Comparisons on every bar. The tolerance comparison disagrees with exact arithmetic on 0 bars on all eight markets, for ratio >= 2, |move| >= 0.25 ATR20 and |move| >= 0.40 ATR20. The plain float comparison disagreed on 847 USDJPY bars (out of 2,493 exact ties) and on 1,018 EURUSD bars. Float noise on ties is at most 1.1e-11 relative. The nearest genuine non-tie is at least 6.0e-4 away (XAUUSD) and 1e-2 on EURUSD. The tolerance therefore sits about two orders of magnitude above the noise and five below any real ratio. (e) Counts: signal bars before 2018-01-01, with the market loaded to the 2024-01-01 holdout start. USDJPY defaults: 160 at delay 0 and delay 1 (92 long, 68 short, on 123 trading days). move_atr_min 0.4: 83 / 83. exclude_news false: 567 / 567. 0.4 with news included: 271 / 271. Every number equals Amendment 2 exactly, and both delays still trade identical episode sets. (f) Checker: the pre-fix module gives 83 entries on the checker's 150k-bar sample and the fixed module 97, so checker.json reflects the fixed file.
